tools.note: Windsurf is now called Devin Desktop (renamed June 2026); windsurf.com/pricing redirects to devin.ai/pricing.

tools.free: 500 AI credits to try, free Framer domain, 1 GB bandwidth
tools.note: Price shown with yearly billing selected. Free plan is for non-commercial use.

tools.free: 5 AI credits/month, unlimited apps, 5K database records
tools.paid_plan: Basic, per month billed yearly ($25 billed monthly)
tools.note: $19/mo is the yearly-billing price ($228/year); Basic is $25 billed monthly (from the pricing page's own price data).
GlideOS plans; Glide Classic has separate pricing.

tools.free: Build mode free with a modest daily quota (resets daily); web and Android apps
tools.note: No separate AI Studio plan: Google AI Pro gives higher daily AI Studio quotas (£18.99 is Google's UK price, not converted; $19.99 in the US). Android apps built in AI Studio can be published to a Google Play testing track (Play developer account needed), and since 13 Oct 2026 Google Play lets you run personal AI Studio apps on your own phone without a developer account (rolling out to select markets, starting with the US).
Standard is $20/mo billed monthly or $17/mo billed yearly; extra credits can be bought.
Higher tier 'Rocket' is $50/month for 250 credits. The free allowance is a one-off pot, not a monthly refresh.

tools.free: 2,000 code completions/month, limited chat and agent use, entry-level models
tools.note: Pro gives unlimited completions plus a monthly pool of GitHub AI Credits for chat and agents (1 credit = $0.01). Pro+ is $39/month.

tools.free: 50 credits/month, open-weight models and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (with limits)
tools.note: Kiro is an AI coding app (IDE) from AWS. First upgrade to Pro gives the rest of that month free plus 500 trial credits. Extra credits $0.04 each. Prices exclude VAT. Teams of 2 or more can pool credits: $20 per seat a month, 500 credits per seat.

tools.free: Individual plan $0: a variety of agent models, unlimited Tab completions and Command requests, basic weekly rate limits
tools.note: Google's agent-first coding app (IDE). No separate Antigravity subscription: Google AI Pro raises the rate limits and adds a flexible AI credit pool (£18.99 is Google's UK price, not converted; $19.99 in the US). Google AI Ultra gives even higher limits.

tools.free: 500 AI credits/month, 50K workload units/month, development version only (no live app)
tools.paid_plan: Starter (web), monthly ($32 billed annually), 1,000 AI credits
tools.note: Free plan is for building and testing; you need Starter to launch a live app. AI credits refresh on the 1st of each month and don't roll over. Mobile and web+mobile plans cost more.
